name: IBY_TEMP_CREDITCARDS
description: IBY_TEMP_CREDITCARDS is the interface table for credit card import

columns.name: TEMP_INSTRID
columns.description: Primary key for this table. For Fusion, the value should come from Fusion common sequence - S_ROW_ID_SEQ

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the interface record. Values are NEW, PROCESSED and REJECTED

columns.name: CCNUMBER
columns.description: The credit card number. It must be numeric.

columns.name: EXPIRYDATE
columns.description: Expiration date of the card

columns.name: ADDRESSID
columns.description: Foreign key to HZ_IMP_LOCATIONS_T.LOCATION_T_ID

columns.name: INSTRBUF
columns.description: Instrument

columns.name: CHNAME
columns.description: Card Holder Name

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the instrument

columns.name: FINAME
columns.description: Financial Institution Name

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: BILLING_ADDR_POSTAL_CODE

columns.name: PURCHASECARD_FLAG

columns.name: PURCHASECARD_SUBTYPE
columns.description: IBY_PURCHASECARD_SUBTYPE include B (Business Card), C (Corporate Card), P (Purchase Card) and U (Unknown).

columns.name: CARD_ISSUER_CODE
